note: Baseline of declared-but-unwired Vanilla 1.21.1 mechanics. Remove an entry only when the audit reports it stale (the mechanic is now live).

density.reason: Mace density bonus damage is not applied: numeric id 6 appears only in enchanting-table/anvil applicability tables, never in a live damage path.

frost_walker.reason: No frosted-ice terrain behaviour; the name only appears in the enchanting/anvil rule table.

luck_of_the_sea.reason: Fishing luck is not applied; numeric id 20 has no live enchant_level consumer.

lure.reason: Fishing wait-time reduction is not applied; numeric id 21 has no live enchant_level consumer.

swift_sneak.reason: Sneak movement speed is not modified; numeric id 37 has no live enchant_level consumer.

wind_burst.reason: The mace wind-burst projectile is not implemented; numeric id 41 has no live enchant_level consumer.

blindness.reason: Registry + name/id map only. Blindness is rendered client-side from the effect packet; no live server-side handler exists.

darkness.reason: effect_darkens_view() exists but is #[allow(dead_code)] with no caller; the tick/visibility path never consults darkness.

dolphins_grace.reason: effect_swim_slow_down() is dead code; only the anticheat allowance models the id, no gameplay consumer.

glowing.reason: effect_outlines_entity() is dead code; no live consumer applies the glow outline.

infested.reason: 1.21.1 post-death silverfish spawn behaviour is not implemented; registry only.

invisibility.reason: effect_is_invisible() is dead code; the effect is only forwarded to the client, never consulted by server logic.

jump_boost.reason: wm_jump_boost_power() is dead code and no player/horse jump path reads the effect amplifier.

levitation.reason: levitation_velocity_delta()/levitation_upward_velocity() are dead code and tick_effects has no levitation arm.

luck.reason: No loot-table or fishing luck consumer reads the effect.

night_vision.reason: effect_grants_night_vision() is dead code; the effect is client-rendered only.

oozing.reason: 1.21.1 post-death slime spawn behaviour is not implemented; registry only.

slow_falling.reason: effect_negates_fall_damage()/slow_falling_gravity_multiplier() are dead code; the gravity/fall path never reads the effect.

trial_omen.reason: Registry-only: the trial-spawner ominous path never reads the effect.

unluck.reason: No loot-table luck consumer reads the effect.

weaving.reason: 1.21.1 post-death cobweb spawn behaviour is not implemented; registry only.

wind_charged.reason: 1.21.1 post-death wind-burst behaviour is not implemented; registry only.
